id: title:bernatixer:skip materialized person columns on ai events reads

review.posthog_relevance: Supports HogQL query execution against the ai-events cluster, potentially avoiding compatibility issues or read failures when querying shared tables without materialized columns.
review.reason: Adds HogQLQueryModifiers and MaterializationMode, including a helper to execute HogQL queries without materialized columns. This could support HogQL query execution against the ai-events cluster while explicitly disabling materialized-column materialization, potentially avoiding read failures or compatibility issues when querying shared tables without mat_*/pmat_* columns.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the ai-events cluster currently lacks these columns or has compatibility constraints; the code change alone does not prove an incident was avoided or that the cluster configuration requires this, though it provides a mechanism to handle such a scenario.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds HogQLQueryModifiers and MaterializationMode imports; removes HogQLQueryModifiers from TYPE_CHECKING; adds _without_materialized_columns helper; passes this helper to execute_hogql_query; updates tests to use HogQLQueryModifiers and assert materializationMode; adds test for person properties without materialized columns.
